name: Ganimed
description: Ganimed were a humanoid sentient species distinguished by the single black horn on top of their hairless heads. The species had pointy ears and a ruddy brown and muddy yellow skin tone. The bounty hunter Purong was a member of the species. By 0 BBY, Purong visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine and engaged in a lightfight against the Ariwook Rff Huff.
